ising2d_correlation_length_beta0_6.cite: exponential correlation length along a lattice axis of the isotropic square-lattice Ising model (J = 1, K = beta), K* the dual coupling, sinh 2K sinh 2K* = 1 (Onsager, 'Crystal Statistics. triangular_beta_c.independent_route: the minimum of the Kac-Ward integrand (Athanasopoulos & Ueltschi, Thm 2.1(b)) vanishes at K_c; K_c is the fixed point of star-triangle o duality (Baxter (6.4.8), (6.3.6)) in balls; Pierre, Bernu & Messio, arXiv:2501.18569, Table 1: v_c = tanh K_c = 2 - sqrt 3 (concordant)

honeycomb_beta_c.cite: critical coupling of the isotropic honeycomb Ising ferromagnet: sinh 2L_c = 3^(1/2), L_c = 0.6584789..., Baxter, Exactly Solved Models (1982), ANU PDF (page images read), Eq. (6.5.7). Value: (1/2) asinh(3^(1/2)) by mpmath at 60 digits; tol 1e-29
honeycomb_beta_c.independent_route: L_c is the fixed point of duality o star-triangle in balls, and its star-triangle image has Baxter's k = 1; Pierre, Bernu & Messio, arXiv:2501.18569, Table 1: v_c = 1/sqrt 3 (concordant); Baxter (11.7.6) l = 1 there
